cat > /workdir/auto.py <<'PY'
import arena,chess,subprocess,sys
n=int(sys.argv[1]);secs=int(sys.argv[2]) if len(sys.argv)>2 else 120
for _ in range(n):
 b=arena.load_board()
 if arena.result(b):
  arena.show(b);break
 fen=b.fen();good=[]
 for m in b.legal_moves:
  b.push(m)
  if not b.is_repetition(3) and not b.is_stalemate():good.append(m.uci())
  b.pop()
 args=['./think',fen,str(secs)]
 if good:args+=[' '.join(good)]
 text=subprocess.check_output(args,text=True)
 print('\n'.join(text.splitlines()[-3:]),flush=True)
 move=text.strip().splitlines()[-1].split()[-1]
 if chess.Move.from_uci(move) not in b.legal_moves:raise RuntimeError(move)
 arena.cmd_move(move)
 sys.stdout.flush()
